name: wrong reading
description: The detector scored something incorrectly — the most useful report there is

name: signal
description: A new detection signal, or a change to one

name: weight change
description: Changes a scoring weight — needs before/after fixture scores

name: enhancement
description: A new feature or an improvement

name: security
description: Security-relevant. Report privately first, never as a public issue

name: dependencies
description: Dependabot — GitHub Actions only, this project has no package dependencies

name: needs evidence
description: Waiting on a fixture, an excerpt, or a reproducible case

name: good first issue
description: Small, self-contained, a good place to start

name: help wanted
description: Input or a contribution would be welcome

name: wontfix
description: Deliberate. Usually because it would need a dependency or would store user data

name: question
description: A question rather than a report
